enterprise_scale_proxy.basis: Observed 75th percentile of the 1144 provisional source cohort, rounded to an integer; usage is a scale heuristic, not verified enterprise status

priority.basis: Exact frozen base/medium_15pct NPV tie boundaries read with round-trip float precision; equality remains in the lower tier

required_executive_disclosures.fiscal_eligibility: Source-reported two-year inactivity is provisional; fiscal eligibility is unconfirmed.
required_executive_disclosures.assumed_probabilities: Reactivation probabilities are assumption-based and not calibrated to observed customer outcomes.
required_executive_disclosures.illustrative_npv: NPV is illustrative net program value, not verified customer profitability.
required_executive_disclosures.no_causal_uplift: Incremental campaign uplift is not causally identified without an untreated counterfactual.
required_executive_disclosures.historical_spend: Historical recorded spend is not ARR or verified recoverable revenue.
required_executive_disclosures.root_financial_overlap: Parent-child billable independence and consolidated root revenue are unverified.
required_executive_disclosures.ticket_velocity: Open tickets are a snapshot backlog proxy; ticket velocity is unobserved.
required_executive_disclosures.revenue_decay: Historical account revenue decay is unobserved.
required_executive_disclosures.missing_feature_bias: Unknown health and sentinel tickets can bias assumed financial rankings.
required_executive_disclosures.hypothetical_offers: The 5, 15, and 30 percent commercial discounts are hypothetical interventions without estimated response elasticity.
required_executive_disclosures.source_discounts: Recorded source discounts differ from the hypothetical commercial offers.
required_executive_disclosures.root_dependence: Within-root reactivation outcomes are modeled as conditionally independent.
required_executive_disclosures.discount_mechanics: Lower discounts are mechanically favored when conversion assumptions do not change; fixed delivery costs may change that comparison.
required_executive_disclosures.scenario_priority_sensitivity: Priority counts under alternative financial scenarios use the fixed base/15% dollar cutoffs. They measure movement across absolute financial thresholds, not changes in relative account rank.
required_executive_disclosures.committed_adverse_stress: Committed Phase 3 combined adverse stress: base hazard multiplier 1.0, $750 monthly gross revenue, 45 percent margin, $150 outreach, $300 activation, 24 percent annual financial discount, at most 3 paid months, 15 percent commercial discount; analytical expected NPV -$124,647.432973.
required_executive_disclosures.alternative_compounded_stress: Separate alternative compounded stress: base hazard multiplier 0.5, $750 monthly gross revenue, 60 percent margin, $150 outreach, $200 activation, 12 percent annual financial discount, at most 3 paid months, 15 percent commercial discount; analytical expected NPV -$124,704.050145.
required_executive_disclosures.no_contact_authorization: No customer-contact action was authorized or executed; every recommendation is planning only.
